main_text.p: Ephodæi testimonio. His accedit .& censor meus. Deinde vim afferre mihi videris huic voci הקראה[?] qvam interpretatis videturne tibi. Est enim conclusio ex præcedentibus collecta,ideo ef-se non potest interrogatio dubitantis, sed affirmantis & colligentis, numqvid vides,&c. ut paulo post idem autor cap.35. התראה נאשר אמר להם [illegible, ~1 letter] חדשה [illegible, ~1 letter] לכם [illegible, ~1 letter] ראש החדשים. Ita etiam est interpretatus pater tuus. Obstat denique ratio totius contextus, est enim sensus juxta tuam sententiam, videturne tibi, quod opus eorum in hoc vanum fuerit, aut occupatio circa rem debitam. At ex toto contextu constat, Karaitas literæ punctis mordicus inhærere. Qvamobrem igitur interrogat Rabbanista Karaitam, an punctatio, &c. sit inutilis, cum non modo utilem & ante & post interrogationem illa Karaita falsus fuerit, sed etiam à Masorethis divinitus adjutis fuisse inscriptam? Unde colligit author adversus Karaitam, eos omnes, qvi fatentur legem punctis, &c. ornatam, ef-se le-

page.notes: The two Hebrew lines contain gaps (blank boxes) where letters did not print or did not survive the scan; these are marked as illegible. The Hebrew word after "voci" is uncertain and marked [?]. The "ef-" / "se" split across lines is a printed hyphenated word, "esse". A small stray mark stands before "Karaita" in "illa Karaita"; it is not a letter and is not transcribed.
